name: XCC_SEG_NOT_BUDGETED_SEG_VAL
description: This table contains a filler segment value for any segment in a ledger's chart of accounts that is excluded from budget data. These segment values are used to fill in any segments that are omitted in the user-provided budget data when the budget data needs to be stored in a data structure that requires all segments in the chart of accounts, such as General Ledger.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Primary ledgers defined in GL and enabled for budgetary control.

columns.name: SOURCE_SEGMENT_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Chart of accounts segment column name, such as SEGMENT1.

columns.name: SEG_VAL_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether a chart of accounts segment can potentially be excluded in user-provided budget data and therefore needs a filler segment value.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Segment value to be used to fill in the segment that is omitted in the user-provided budget data when budget data needs to be stored in data structure that requires all segments in the chart of accounts.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
